notes.title: V1.2 Content update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43832081/3a34d33f270ccf1994f3b611ffdcd934ae838460.png

Spaceship Survivors V1.2
- Texture optimization.
- HP is reduced for enemies, but more enemies will spawn.
- Shadow enemies spawn after 20 minutes.
- 2 new final bosses for Tier 1, Tier 2 hard modes.
- Blue skill item chance buff.
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: V1.1 Content update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43832081/822b835b61d1a0b58e227ab3a233542ce8ba3902.jpg

Spaceship Survivors V1.1
- New pilot level system, you can upgrade your pilots for stats and skills.
- Normal mode gameplay changes
- Two new Hard modes (Tier 1, Tier 2)
- Two new pilots (Kyo and Kimi)
- Two new skins for completing hard modes
- 10 new skill items
- bug fixes

Kyo
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43832081/2ebafee9ba622cccf88ed05d33b2477eb6788f69.png
He is a master of power and laser weapons.

Max level: 30
+ 1 impact damage/level
+ radar drone.
Bonus at level 10:
+50% XP.
Bonus skill at level 20:
Ring technology upgrade (laser).
Bonus skill at level 30:
Ultimate laser upgrade.
+ 100% support package efficiency.

Kimi
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43832081/ee046f352a7d086b3abb78a39ba5acca397a763d.png
He is a master at combining impact and fire damage.

Max level: 30
+1 impact damage/level
+ 100% explosion area.
Bonus at level 10:
+30% XP.
Bonus skill at level 20:
Explosions now cause fire.
Bonus skill at level 30:
Ignited enemies gain increased impact damage.
